title: Change the profile cover and reopen settings to view the selected image
steps: Open Change cover and select Cover image 3.
Open the avatar menu and select Settings.

video_guide.summary: The selected star-trails cover survives saving, closing, and reopening Profile settings.

chapters.note: Profile settings begins with the black-sand cover.
Change cover opens the image picker.

chapters.label: Select and save the star-trails cover

chapters.note: The star-trails cover is displayed and the profile-update success notification appears.
The reopened profile still displays the star-trails cover.
